translations.web: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
translations.bsb: And you are proud! Shouldn’t you rather have been stricken with grief and have removed from your fellowship the man who did this?
translations.kjv: And ye are puffed up, and have ➔ not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
